newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group closes $100 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group closes $100 mln credit line.

text.p: Diversified personnel staffing services company Personnel Group of America Inc said on Tuesday it closed a $100 million three-year revolving credit agreement with NationsBank.
The company said in a statement the new line replaced a $30 million credit facility with the same bank.
The company said the facility allowed it to finance its two most recent acquisitions and pursue further acquisitions.

"We have acquired eight companies in 1996, with combined annual revenues in excess of $150 million and continue to see excellent opportunities within the staffing services industry and particularly in the information technology staffing sector," Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Edward Drudge Jr. said.
